seo.meta_title: Wings Etc Sauces: Every Flavor From Mild to Wall
seo.meta_description: Wings Etc sauces range from Mild and Tweener up to TNT and the habanero Wall, plus BBQ, Asian, honey and garlic flavors and seven ranch-style dips.

question: What Sauces Does Wings Etc Have?
quick_answer: Wings Etc. Grill & Pub offers more than 20 wing flavors. The buffalo heat ladder runs from Buffalo and Mild up through Tweener, Hot Buffalo and TNT (buffalo with black pepper) to Wall, a habanero sauce that's the hottest on the menu. Sweeter and savory picks include Honey BBQ, Mahalo-Que, Sweet Chili Cha-Cha, Say It Ain't Tso, Wango, Hummmin' Hot Honey, Hot-Honey-Garlic and Gar-Licky Parm. Dips include house Ranch, Ranch Fire, Dill Ranch and Blue Cheese.
key_facts: Buffalo ladder: Mild, Tweener, Hot Buffalo, TNT
Sweet heat: Wango, Hummmin' Hot Honey, Asian Kick
Ranch Flight: any 3 ranch dips for about $2.69

body.heading: The buffalo heat ladder
body.text: Wings Etc's classic buffalo sauces climb in heat. Buffalo and Mild (buffalo with a bit of heat) are the gentlest. Tweener sits between mild and hot, as its name suggests. Hot Buffalo turns it up, and TNT adds black pepper to buffalo for a sharper burn. At the top is Wall, made with habanero, which Wings Etc lists first on its flavor chart. Older menus also listed a Suicide level between TNT and Wall.

body.heading: BBQ and sweet-heat flavors
body.text: For something less fiery, Wings Etc offers Honey BBQ, House BBQ, Hot Barbie (a spicy BBQ) and Mahalo-Que, a pineapple BBQ. Wango blends habanero with mango for sweet heat, and there's also Brown Sugar Bourbon. Hummmin' Hot Honey and Hot-Honey-Garlic are the hot-honey options.

body.heading: Asian, garlic and other flavors
body.text: Asian-style picks include Asian Kick (sweet heat), Sweet Chili Cha-Cha, Say It Ain't Tso and Teriyaki. Gar-Licky Parm is the garlic parmesan choice, and Honey Mustard is a mild, tangy option. The menu also lists dry-style flavors such as Caribbean Jerk and Mojito Lime-Pepper, and you can add Cajun Dust or Garlic Dust to an order.

body.heading: Dips and the Ranch Flight
body.text: Wings come with celery or carrots and a dip. Ranch options include House Ranch, Ranch Fire, Parm-Garlic Ranch, Dill Ranch and Buffalo Ranch, plus Blue Cheese and BFD Sauce, a house sauce. The Ranch Flight lets you pick any three ranch flavors for about $2.69. You can also buy extra wing sauce to take home, in sizes from 2 ounces to a 10 or 12 ounce cup.

body.heading: Wing prices and ordering tips
body.text: At one Indiana location, 10 traditional wings are about $14.99 and 10 boneless about $12.99, with counts from 6 to 30. Wing Bundles of 20 to 40 wings come with fries or tots, dips and celery. Catering wing orders let you choose up to six sauces. Prices vary by location. See our Wings Etc menu for more.

faqs.q: What is the hottest sauce at Wings Etc?
faqs.a: Wall, a habanero sauce, is the hottest on the Wings Etc flavor chart.

faqs.q: What is Tweener sauce at Wings Etc?
faqs.a: Tweener is a buffalo sauce between Mild and Hot in heat.

faqs.q: What is TNT sauce at Wings Etc?
faqs.a: TNT is a hot buffalo sauce with black pepper, one step below Wall.

faqs.q: Does Wings Etc sell its sauce?
faqs.a: Yes. You can buy extra wing sauce by the cup, from 2 ounces up to about 12 ounces.

faqs.q: How many sauces does Wings Etc have?
faqs.a: Wings Etc says it has 22 signature sauces and dips, and the current menu lists more than 20 wing flavors.
